verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documents per-data-source segregation, so you can delete or update data in one source without affecting others. On-premise and self-hosted deployment options also give users direct control over where data lives. However, nothing in the evidence describes retention policies, TTLs, guaranteed deletion of derived embeddings, or any privacy-focused deletion controls. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods/TTL, documented hard-delete guarantees covering generated embeddings and AI/answer session logs, account/project-level data purge docs, independent corroboration.
